items.text:
Agents mostly tried to buy a Hedgehog Hoodie shipped to Brazil, and checkout blocked them because it only serves seven countries.

- 10 of 22 people asked for Brazil shipping, and checkout serves only US, CA, GB, DE, FR, NL and AU.
- 6 people wanted a medium Hedgehog Hoodie, which was sold out, with no restock or back-order option.
- 7 people wanted a kids-size tee, but the catalog only has adult sizes XS to XXL.

What I would do next: Add Brazil (BR) to the countries checkout ships to, since it blocks the most people.

```chart
{"title":"People blocked, last 24h","bars":[{"label":"Ship to Brazil","value":10},{"label":"Kids-size tee","value":7},{"label":"Medium hoodie restock","value":6},{"label":"Gift wrap or discount","value":2},{"label":"Water bottle","value":2}]}
```

Of the 22 people, 17 have no identity, so I counted each anonymous ID as one person. Those counts could be too high if one person appears under several IDs.
